# SelectionMode

`Flare.Components.Combobox.SelectionMode`

How many items a combobox may hold selected at once.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Single` | `0` | At most one selected value (FlareSelect, FlareCombobox). |
| `Multiple` | `1` | Any number of selected values (FlareMultiSelect, FlareTagField). |

## Used by components

- `FlareDataGrid`
